item.title: Welcome to My Blog
item.description:
Welcome to My Technical Blog

Hello and welcome to my blog! This is where I share my journey in software development, system design, and technology exploration.

What to Expect

Technical Content

  • Backend Development: Java, Spring Boot, microservices
  • Database: MySQL optimization, Redis caching strategies
  • System Design: Scalable architecture patterns
  • Algorithms: LeetCode solutions and analysis

Learning Notes

I believe in learning in public. You’ll find my notes on:

  • New technologies I’m exploring
  • Books I’m reading
  • Conferences and talks I attend
